name: Algo Lab — Sorting, Pathfinding, Search, Databases & Hypervisors
description: Interactive systems lab: 16 sorting algorithms, 9 pathfinding algorithms, 7 search algorithms, a working SQL database engine (B+ trees, buffer pool, WAL, crash recovery, query planner) and a hypervisor simulator (trap-and-emulate, EPT vs shadow paging, vCPU scheduling, memory overcommit, live migration). Teaching mode, step-through, and offline support.
